system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:36:09, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a PowerShell process running as SYSTEM attempting to use explicit credentials for svc-render when targeting PROXY-NWD-01. This is anomalous against the supplied inventory, which assigns svc-render to the RenderQueue job on FILE-NWD-01 and does not describe help-desk use of that account.

From 13:32 through 13:47, FILE-NWD-01 repeatedly logged failed network logons for svc-render, generally about once per minute, from 10.40.20.20 (FILE-NWD-01) using the same process ID. The records report bad-password status; this pattern is consistent with the scheduled password rotation and a job that re-authenticates each run but does not, by itself, establish malicious activity.
The domain controller also recorded svc-render authentication failures associated with FILE-NWD-01 during this period, including NTLM validation failures and Kerberos pre-authentication failures.

The explicit-credential event establishes an attempt to use svc-render from WS-NBLAKE-01, but does not establish that the proxy authentication succeeded. Given the account's documented purpose and the unusual source and target, the attempt warrants treatment as suspected credential misuse.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage, so proxy-side authentication results or activity around the explicit-credential event cannot be checked.
The supplied evidence contains no process-tree or command-line detail beyond the PowerShell image and process ID in T042-00009.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-render credential attempt from WS-NBLAKE-01 succeeded or generated any proxy activity.
Who or what initiated the PowerShell process on WS-NBLAKE-01, and what command or script it ran.
Whether the scheduled password rotation occurred at 13:30 and whether the RenderQueue job was updated afterward.
Whether any successful svc-render authentication or subsequent access occurred during the review window.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain PROXY-NWD-01 authentication and access logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including any retained or upstream records covering the collection outage.
Collect PowerShell operational/script-block logs, process creation telemetry, and parent-process details from WS-NBLAKE-01 around 13:36 UTC.
Review authentication success and access records for svc-render on the proxy, domain controller, and relevant hosts during the review window.
Verify the password-rotation and RenderQueue update records, including who performed the changes and when.
